preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The number of cities N must be between 2 and 5000.
The number of proposals from other companies M1 must be between 1 and 20000.
The number of proposals from Chef's company M2 must be between 1 and 20000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c <= 1000000000 for _, _, c in roads)
preconditions.description: The cost c of each proposed road must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' if not connected else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to connect all cities, output 'Impossible'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == f'{max_profit} {min_total_cost}' if connected else True
postconditions.description: If it is possible to connect all cities, output the maximum profit and minimum total cost.
